decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher draws directly on the firm's core postpress application and service know-how, so the firm can read market feedback and refine it, though the 2024 withdrawals of close-to-core products show that portfolio pruning is under way.

The sheet preparation module builds on the firm's modular finishing systems and complements the remaining products, but with no reported results the firm has less evidence to learn from, so the withdrawal risk is moderate.

The folding add-on unit is close to the core offer and has a documented customer installation running in one pass, so the firm has results it can interpret and the product links well with the cutting and creasing line.
